proposed_fixes.title: Honor the configured non-elevated startup
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: the startup task, launcher elevation, or stored setting causes an elevated process despite the disabled preference; the actual source is unconfirmed.
plan: Check actual process elevation, the stored preference, launch origin, and scheduled-task settings for logon and manual launches.
Trace the verified failing startup path without assuming JSON edits change the current process token.
Correct PowerToys-controlled startup behavior if it retains elevation incorrectly and cover existing elevated-launch and restart paths.
verification: A normal launch and configured startup run non-elevated when the preference is off; explicitly elevated launches remain possible.

reproduce.title: Honor the configured non-elevated startup
prerequisites: Windows account with permission to inspect its own scheduled tasks
setup: Disable Always run as administrator and fully exit PowerToys.
steps: Start PowerToys normally and record the actual process elevation.
Restart Windows and compare the logon-started process.
Inspect the PowerToys startup task and launcher compatibility settings without changing unrelated policy.
reproduce.expected_result: Normal launch and logon startup honor the disabled elevation preference.
